A03-CAPSTONE.apply:
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import linear_sum_assignment
t=np.asarray(data["truth"],int);p=np.asarray(data["pred"],int)
tids=[x for x in np.unique(t) if x>0];pids=[x for x in np.unique(p) if x>0]
m=np.zeros((len(tids),len(pids)),float)
for i,a in enumerate(tids):
    for j,b in enumerate(pids):
        inter=np.count_nonzero((t==a)&(p==b));union=np.count_nonzero((t==a)|(p==b))
        m[i,j]=inter/union if union else 0.0
valid=m>=data["cutoff"]
if m.size:
    rr,cc=linear_sum_assignment(-(valid*(min(m.shape)+1)+m*valid))
    tp=sum(bool(valid[i,j]) for i,j in zip(rr,cc))
else:tp=0
fp=len(pids)-tp;fn=len(tids)-tp
f1=2*tp/(2*tp+fp+fn) if 2*tp+fp+fn else 1.0
inter=np.count_nonzero((t>0)&(p>0));union=np.count_nonzero((t>0)|(p>0))
result={"tp":int(tp),"fp":int(fp),"fn":int(fn),"f1":float(f1),"foreground_pixel_iou":float(inter/union if union else 1.0),"biological_validated":False}
print(result)
